core: Surface epithelial and pigment cell differentiation
qualifier: epidermal keratinocyte, MITF-driven melanocyte and intestinal absorptive epithelium
name: Epidermal, melanocyte and intestinal epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte cornification and skin appendage development, MITF-M melanocyte and melanosome programmes, and HNF4/CDX intestinal epithelium modules, whereas the ectodermal confusables centre on tooth, ear or pancreatic development and lack the melanocyte and intestinal components.

core: Nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
qualifier: endothelial eNOS activation and trafficking
name: Endothelial nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
rationale: Members concern eNOS activation, trafficking and BH4 cofactor supply, NO-cGMP signalling and resulting smooth muscle relaxation and blood pressure control, which the renin-angiotensin and smooth muscle contraction confusables lack.

qualifier: strand invasion and recombination intermediate resolution
name: Homologous recombination repair via strand invasion and resolution
rationale: Members describe recombinational repair steps (strand invasion, SDSA, break-induced replication, sister chromatid exchange, intermediate resolution, repair synthesis), distinguishing it from NHEJ/DSB-sensing, telomere and replication-initiation confusables.

qualifier: nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
name: Nucleoside transport, triphosphate hydrolysis and analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover plasma membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport, NUDT and triphosphate catabolism, and handling of thiopurine and nucleoside-analogue drugs, whereas confusables are de novo and salvage nucleotide biosynthesis without transport.

qualifier: SA-node pacemaker depolarization by HCN channels
name: Action potential regulation and SA-node pacemaker depolarization
rationale: Members regulate action potential firing, propagation and hyperpolarization including HCN-driven SA node depolarization, while confusables concern resting membrane potential and K2P or KATP leak channels.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase and pantothenate-derived CoA synthesis
name: Coenzyme A synthesis and pyruvate dehydrogenase acetyl-CoA production
rationale: Members are CoA biosynthesis from pantothenate and PDH-catalysed pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA, distinct from TCA/shuttle, other 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and NAD metabolism confusables.

qualifier: forebrain neuroblast and asymmetric division
name: Forebrain neural progenitor proliferation and asymmetric division
rationale: All members concern maintenance and division of forebrain neural stem/progenitor cells, whereas confusables cover glial fate, neuronal migration, spindle orientation or forebrain patterning.

qualifier: hydroxylation, diphthamide and selenocysteine
name: Protein hydroxylation, diphthamide and selenocysteine residue modification
rationale: Members are unusual residue modifications (proline/lysine hydroxylation, diphthamide on EEF2 histidine, formylglycine activation of sulfatases, selenocysteine insertion), distinct from confusables centred on tRNA modification, hypusine or methylation.

qualifier: ceramide and sphingomyelin
name: Ceramide and sphingomyelin metabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo sphingoid and sphingomyelin synthesis, sphingomyelin catabolism to ceramide and sphingolipid homeostasis, whereas all confusables concern glycerophospholipids.

qualifier: early stages from intermediate mesoderm to S-shaped body
name: Early nephrogenesis from intermediate mesoderm to S-shaped body
rationale: Members trace early kidney development (intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme-to-epithelium, renal vesicle, comma and S-shaped bodies), while confusables cover distal tubule, collecting duct, ureter or kidney size control.

qualifier: ganglioside GM2 hexosaminidase degradation
name: Lysosomal ganglioside and glycosphingolipid catabolism
rationale: Members concern glycosphingolipid and ganglioside breakdown including HEXA/HEXB GM2 gangliosidoses, while confusables concern glycosaminoglycan, oligosaccharide or sialic acid catabolism.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and glucocorticoid stress axis
name: Neuroendocrine control of growth, appetite and glucocorticoid stress response
rationale: Members span GH/prolactin/leptin/ghrelin signalling, feeding behaviour and HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion and response, which confusables (gut peptide GPCRs, beta-cell development, neuropeptide behaviours) lack.

core: Exocytic vesicle tethering at the plasma membrane
qualifier: exocyst-dependent GLUT4 translocation
name: Exocyst vesicle tethering in GLUT4 plasma membrane delivery
rationale: Members cover exocyst localization and vesicle tethering, RHOQ cycling and GLUT4 translocation, whereas confusables address insulin signalling and glucose import without the tethering machinery.
The three members (osmotic-stress anti-apoptosis, mitochondrial depolarization, nucleotide biosynthesis inhibition) share no nameable biological process.

qualifier: retinol and retinal handling and STRA6 uptake
name: Vitamin A (retinol) metabolism and cellular uptake
rationale: Members concern retinol/retinal metabolism and transport including STRA6-mediated uptake, distinct from confusables centred on retinoic acid synthesis/catabolism or the visual retinoid cycle.

qualifier: chondroitin and dermatan sulfate
name: Chondroitin and dermatan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover linkage-region and CS/DS chain synthesis and their Ehlers-Danlos and skeletal dysplasia defects, whereas confusables concern heparan or keratan sulfate and other O-glycosylation.

qualifier: melanosome and platelet dense granule
name: Biogenesis of melanosomes and other lysosome-related organelles
rationale: Members concern coat-mediated cargo loading into melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles, distinct from general Golgi/lysosome vesicle biogenesis, melanin synthesis and clathrin endocytosis confusables.

qualifier: regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and antifungal response
name: Regulation of antimicrobial peptide and antifungal humoral defence
rationale: Members regulate antimicrobial peptide production, antibacterial and antifungal humoral responses and neutrophil killing, while confusables centre on defensins, mucosal bacterial attachment and metal sequestration.

core: Oxygenated polyunsaturated fatty acid mediator biosynthesis
qualifier: lipoxygenase eicosanoids and specialized pro-resolving mediators
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid and pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, HETE, hepoxilin, lipoxin and EET synthesis plus resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis, which confusables (omega-hydroxylation, prostanoid/leukotriene receptors) lack.

qualifier: sleep-wake regulation
name: Neuropeptide G-protein signalling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members combine orexin/neuropeptide receptor signalling and G-protein activation with control of REM, non-REM sleep and wakefulness, whereas confusables link neuropeptides to feeding, mating or other behaviours.

core: Viral downregulation of host surface receptors
qualifier: HIV Nef
name: HIV Nef-mediated downregulation of host immune surface receptors
rationale: All members are Nef-driven removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC class I from the cell surface, distinct from antigen presentation, other HIV life-cycle and host antiviral confusables.

qualifier: beta-cell secretion coupling and insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
name: Insulin secretion and insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
rationale: Members cover beta-cell KATP and incretin/fatty-acid control of insulin secretion and insulin receptor signalling to GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis, while confusables centre on glucagon/gluconeogenesis or fatty acid oxidation.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans, glycolipids, oligosaccharides and amino sugar metabolism
name: Lysosomal glycoconjugate degradation and amino sugar metabolism
rationale: Members cover lysosomal breakdown of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), glycosphingolipids and oligosaccharides plus sialic acid and hexosamine metabolism, while confusables are glycan biosynthesis and glycosylation disorders.

qualifier: G1/S transition via RB1-E2F, CDKs and p53
name: G1/S transition control by RB1, CDKs and p53
rationale: Members centre on RB1-E2F, cyclin D/E-CDK activity, CDK inhibitor and Cdc25A degradation and p53 regulation at G1/S, whereas confusables emphasize G2/M checkpoints, APC/C and replication licensing.

qualifier: amyloid-beta handling and lysosomal function
name: Microglial activation, lysosomal function and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members regulate microglial differentiation and activation, lysosome organization and amyloid-beta formation and clearance, while confusables lack microglial differentiation or focus on amyloid fibrils or glial proliferation alone.
